data.title: 黑歌 · 海礁石上的猫耳比基尼日光浴
data.description: 碧海蓝天之下，黑歌斜卧在海边微温的平滑礁石上，黑色系带比基尼勾勒丰腴曲线，双尾在海风中惬意摆动。
data.action: 斜倚在微热礁石上，单手支颌，双腿微曲交叠，修长黑尾轻扫水花
data.lighting: 耀眼纯净的夏日阳光，海面折射的晶莹水光反衬肌肤
data.camera: 低角度仰视全身，展现修长比例与海天一色
data.promptProse: Kuroka sunbathes languidly atop a smooth, sun-warmed volcanic rock surrounded by crystalline ocean tides. Her strappy black bikini accentuates her sun-kissed, curvaceous frame, with droplets of seawater sparkling along her skin. Propping her chin lazily in one palm with her twin feline tails dipping into the warm foam below, she casts a sultry, feline gaze toward the viewer beneath the radiant sun.
data.animaCaption: Reclining against sun-warmed coastal rocks, Kuroka sunbathes in her strappy black bikini with twin tails dipping into the sea.
